answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 390 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The quill graph is validated at intake and the prism frontier is published, and as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and wander anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Collateral of 67 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
